{"answer": "**What's wrong** You've put `aria-checked="false"` on a `
` with `role="button"`. The button role doesn't support the `aria-checked` attribute. According to the HTML-ARIA specification, a button element can only use global ARIA attributes and attributes that apply to the button role — and `aria-checked` is not one of them. **Who it affects** A screen reader user activates this control and hears it announced as a button, but the checked state is ignored. If this button is meant to toggle something on or off, they have no way to know the current state. **The fix** If this button toggles alert subscriptions on and off, use the `switch` role instead of `button`: ```html
Subscribe to service alerts
``` The `switch` role is designed for this exact use case — a control that has two states (on/off, checked/unchecked) — and it properly supports `aria-checked`. If this button does something else and doesn't actually toggle state, remove the `aria-checked` attribute entirely.", "tool_calls": 0}
